title: Nirvana Shatkam
author: Adi Shankaracharya
intro: Six verses by Adi Shankaracharya on the nature of the Self, also called Atma Shatkam. Each verse says what the Self is not, and ends with the same refrain: चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम्, 'my form is consciousness and bliss; I am Shiva'.
note: Six verses, each ending with the same refrain.
